items.markdown:
If you need roof repair in the Tampa, Florida area, I’d focus on **licensed, insured roofing contractors with strong recent reviews, local references, and experience repairing—not just replacing—roofs.** Tampa’s heavy rain, humidity, and storm activity make it especially important to find someone who can identify the actual source of a leak and stand behind the repair.

I’d shortlist a few companies, compare their reviews and warranties, and get at least two written estimates before committing.

## How to choose a reliable roofer

Before you hire anyone, I recommend these four checks\:

- **Verify the Florida license** through the [Florida DBPR license lookup](https://www.myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp)\.
- Request proof of general liability insurance and workers’ compensation coverage, as applicable.
- Get a written estimate detailing the cause of the problem, materials, labor, and workmanship warranty.
- Compare at least two estimates and check recent reviews for similar repair jobs, not just roof replacements.

Avoid paying the full amount upfront, and be cautious of anyone pressuring you to sign an insurance claim agreement immediately.
